bundle.shortDescription: English and Russian dictation and offline text to speech
bundle.longDescription: Independent English and Russian interface, dictation and synthesis. Optional Moonshine/GigaAM dictation and noncommercial Silero TTS components download separately. One compact application, with no bundled speech models or speech runtimes.
